documents.title: Update On Proposed Investment In M/S. Siravit Ceramics Private Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q1 FY27 sales grew moderately by 3% while value grew by 24%, impacted by a temporary shutdown in Morbi during April. EBITDA margins expanded by 3.6% to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization (83% stand-alone) and improved performance in joint ventures. The company announced plans to set up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South with a capex outlay of approximately INR220 crores, alongside debottlenecking across existing lines. Management expressed confidence in sustaining or improving current EBITDA margins and expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter will be maintained and they are trying to better them.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth for the year to be in the mid-single digits.
Management stated that the upcoming South plant will provide a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management guided to improve EBITDA margin from the current base by at least 1.5% or more.
guidance.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: Management stated that brand spend will go up a little bit while maintaining it in percentage terms due to top line and volume growth.
guidance.quote: Brand spend will also go up a little bit, although in percentage terms, we will maintain it as we have taken aggressive growth on our top line growth and the value volume growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth for the tile business to be in very decent single digits for FY27.
guidance.quote: '27 number, we should be able to get a decent single-digit growth in terms of volume.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates sanitaryware and adhesive business growth to be in very healthy double digits.
guidance.quote: For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was pretty decent, and July has not been bad despite rains in many parts of the country.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, management is extremely bullish on the future outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand seems to be absolutely good.
demand_outlook.quote: And demand seems to be absolutely good.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the industry's growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: March was an aberration month due to geopolitical circumstances affecting exports and sailings.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South that will be ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is taking steps to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in existing lines in Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex outlay from now to the end of FY27 is looked at approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the growing Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: An investment of INR30 crores was made to improve the utilization level in Somany Max by putting a press.
capex_expansion.quote: We put in an investment of INR30 crores to make the utilization level better in Somany Max by putting the press.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex will be contained within INR70 crores to INR80 crores for routine capex and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: So everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins increased by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Blended natural gas price comes in at about INR68, with South and Morbi at mid-70s and North around INR68-INR69.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68. And South, we're still buying partly in spot. So South is -- South and Morbi are pretty much at the same level, which is close to mid-70s. And in the North, it is slightly lower, which is around the INR68, INR69 level.

margins_costs.claim: The company took a price hike of an average of about 16%, 17%.
margins_costs.quote: We took a price hike of -- you can take an average of about 16%, 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Sales growth was about 6% in Q4 and 5% for the entire year, while EBITDA improved significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and 1% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: As far as we are concerned, sales growth has been about 6% in Q4 and 5% for the entire year, slightly better than last year. EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Brand spend for the year was about 2%, slightly lower due to getting rid of the superstar.
margins_costs.quote: As far as our business is concerned, our brand spend has been about 2% for the year. We got rid of the superstar and therefore, it's slightly lower because of that reason.

margins_costs.claim: Gas prices increased very significantly after the war broke out in March.
margins_costs.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that. I'm sure there'll be a lot of question-answers around that.

margins_costs.claim: In retail, the company has been able to pass on 100% of the cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: But in the retail, we've been able to pass on 100% of the cost.

margins_costs.claim: Average price increase in tiles since March to the current period is around 16% to 17%.
margins_costs.quote: So in tiles, since March, when this whole crisis started to now, the average price increase is around 16% to 17% as far as tile is concerned.

orders_capacity.claim: Morbi resumed 100% production at the end of May.
orders_capacity.quote: May end onwards, they've been absolutely at 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%. So that is largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: Tiles volume showed an increase in GVT sales by 3%, with a corresponding reduction in ceramic and PVT by 3%.
orders_capacity.quote: If you see the tiles volume, we have increased our GVT sales by 3%, and there's been a reduction in the ceramic and PVT by 3% correspondingly.

orders_capacity.claim: Sanitaryware grew by 8% for the entire year, closing at INR320 crores up from INR296 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Net new dealer additions reached 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.
orders_capacity.quote: The net dealer addition has been very strong this year. We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

orders_capacity.claim: Max plant achieved a breakeven, compared to a loss of about INR9 crores in the corresponding quarter last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Max plant did -- there's good news there that we almost did a breakeven at Max plant. Corresponding quarter last year, same quarter of Q4, the loss was about INR9 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently running its plants at 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So we're running plant at 100% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: About 60% to 65%-70% of the capex will be funded through internal accruals.
Working capital was managed fairly well, being marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital, we've done fairly well. It's marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have been extremely volatile with small increases every month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports from Morbi were down 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: March was an aberration month due to geopolitical circumstances affecting export sailings.
risks_headwinds.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a major labor shortage currently in Morbi affecting plant operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi.

risks_headwinds.claim: Unorganized inefficient players in Morbi are facing severe demand pressure following sharp price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: So with that kind of a sharp increase, they are having trouble facing demand.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the new 9 million square meter plant in the South would be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores. Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

management_commitments.claim: The South plant will be operational at the end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: Debottlenecking and balancing equipment enhancements will mostly be concluded by the end of quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: That is happening now, which -- most of which will be concluded by end of quarter 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company's focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to leverage its strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more.
management_commitments.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a very aggressive double-digit growth target for sanitaryware.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
